description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Docusign is hiring a Software Engineer for its Agreement Orchestration Platform team. The role contributes to designing, developing, and testing software for high-scale, low-latency services and a no-code business process automation framework.
Software Engineer developing and testing Agreement Orchestration Platform components, assisting with microservices, cloud features, and system reliability

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with senior engineers to design, develop, and test software components for the Agreement Orchestration Platform
• Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code backed by comprehensive unit and integration test suites
• Assist in implementing microservices and cloud-based features following established team patterns and best practices under guidance
• Work closely with product management and teammates to understand feature requirements and deliver well-scoped tasks on time
• Participate actively in code reviews, engineering discussions, and agile ceremonies to continuously build technical skills and contribute to the team
• Participate in on-call rotations with guidance from senior engineers to learn operational best practices, triage issues, and support system reliability

Requirements:
• Experience in software development or equivalent academic/internship experience
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, Informatics, or a related field
• Experience with core computer science fundamentals, including data structures and algorithms
• Experience with at least one modern programming language (e.g., C#, Go, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python)
• Applicants must already be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time, permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship

Preferred:
• Familiarity with cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, or equivalent) through coursework, personal projects, or internships
• Exposure to building simple REST APIs or web services
• Basic knowledge of software development best practices, including version control (git) and testing
• Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills
• Enthusiasm for learning new technologies and working in a dynamic, agile environment
